    SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) AS threshold
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT sum(li.l_extendedprice)/7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem li
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = li.l_partkey
JOIN avg_qty aq ON aq.l_partkey = li.l_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
  AND li.l_quantity < aq.threshold
LIMIT 1;

WITH avg_qty AS (
  SELECT l_partkey, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_q
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem li
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = li.l_partkey
JOIN avg_qty a ON a.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
  AND li.l_quantity < 0.2 * a.avg_q
LIMIT 1;
